frame_1.text: I was struck by a carriage and died on the street. It was cold. I was drunk.

frame_2.text: I lay there in a street, yet at the same time I approached a light. It shone so bright and white hot it seared me.

frame_3.text: I turned away. I heard a voice ask:

frame_4.text: 'Not ready to pay your debts? Perhaps, you would like some borrowed time?'

frame_5.text: That day I made a deal. I died, yet have remained, in this empty form, borrowing time from the blood of living beings.

frame_6.text: And by living on and on, I now stand here on the eve of the end of the world, with nothing but a machine to talk to..

frame_7.text: M.I.R.R.O.R.: I am a supercomputer, not just a machine.

frame_8.text: vampire: You are as lifeless as I. Yet you can know it not. Just a relic of past humankind, with only a devil like me to benefit from it all in these last days.

frame_9.text: M.I.R.R.O.R.: Calculating what will happen first, you die or the world ends…

frame_11.text: M.I.R.R.O.R.: Estimated 5 minutes before the end of the world. Calculating your time before death...

frame_12.text: vampire: I am as dead at this moment. There are hardly any animals left, just rats, and even fewer humans. I must have blood to survive.

frame_14.text: What has it all been for? Why am I here? Does any of it matter? What am I even asking- I mean - I mean - what is the meaning of what I should be asking?

frame_15.text: M.I.R.R.O.R - you are the culmination of all that mankind built in its glory, surely your calculations shall yield the most correct answer!

frame_16.text: Answer me why- what-, answer I beg of you!
